claims.claim: The pilot combined training, access hubs, device support, and community governance.
120 residents completed introductory training and 18 completed advanced maintenance training.
The hubs recorded 4,800 unique visits during the six-month pilot.
caveats: Visits are not equivalent to unique people.

claims.claim: Survey respondents reported educational, income-related, and service uses.
caveats: Self-reported use is not a verified outcome.
